items.title: 15.9 Crystals se X-ray ka diffraction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of X-ray diffraction by crystals (PDF 56-57).

blocks.text: X-rays bohat chhoti wavelength, taqreeban 10^-10 m, ki electromagnetic shuaein hain. Diffraction dekhne ke liye grating spacing istemal hone wali shua ki wavelength ke darje ki honi chahiye. Crystal mein atoms ki ba-qaida tarteeb qudrati diffraction grating banati hai jis ki spacing aam taur par taqreeban 10^-10 m hai. Crystal lattice ke atoms se X-rays ka bikhrao aam grating par nazar aane wali roshni jaise diffraction asraat deta hai.

Crystals ki atomic banawat ka X-rays se mutala 1914 mein W. H. Bragg aur W. L. Bragg ne shuru kiya. Unhon ne dekha ke aik rang ki X-ray shua crystal ki satah se aise mun'akis hoti hai jaise aaine se. Ise samajhne ke liye crystal ki satah ke mutawazi muqarrara faasle d wali atomic satahon ka silsila lein (Fig 15.18 mein lakeerein PP', P1P1', P2P2'). X-ray shua satahon par theta zawiye se parti hai. Yeh oopar aur neeche dono satahon se mun'akis hoti hai, aur neeche ki satah se mun'akis shua izafi faasla tay karti hai: dono mun'akis shuaon ka rasta farq 2d sin(theta) hai. Taqwiyat ke liye yeh wavelengths ka poora adad hona chahiye: 2d sin(theta) = n lambda (15.8).

blocks.title: Bragg equation
blocks.text: 2d sin(theta) = n lambda, jahan d atomic satahon ka faasla, theta X-rays aur satahon ke darmiyan glancing zawiya, aur n inikas ka order hai. Agar maloom wavelength ki X-rays crystal se diffract hon to yeh equation us ki mutawazi satahon ka faasla deti hai.

blocks.alt: Crystal mein d faasle par atomic satahein PP', P1P1' aur P2P2', jaal ke nuqton par atoms. X-ray shuaein I aur II theta zawiye par parti hain; I oopar wali satah ke A par aur II agli satah ke C par, jo A ke bilkul neeche hai, mun'akis hoti hai. A se dashed amood shua II ko B aur B' par milte hain; surkh hisse BC aur CB' har aik d sin theta hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.18: Crystal se X-rays ka diffraction (kitab ki Figure 15.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: X-ray diffraction haemoglobin, jo khoon ka ahem juz hai, aur DNA ki double-helix banawat jaise hayatiyati taur par ahem molecules ki banawat maloom karne mein bohat mufeed raha hai.

1.54 x 10^-10 m wavelength ki X-rays crystal se 15.9 darje ke glancing zawiye par first-order inikas deti hain. Satahon ka faasla maloom karein. Hal: d = n lambda / (2 sin(theta)) = (1)(1.54 x 10^-10) / (2 x 0.274) = 2.81 x 10^-10 m.

blocks.prompt: Aam lakeeron wali grating X-rays ko diffract karne mein kyun use nahi ho sakti?
blocks.explanation: Is ki spacing (taqreeban 10^-6 m) X-ray wavelengths (taqreeban 10^-10 m) se hazaron guna bari hai, is liye diffraction ke zawiye bohat chhote hote; crystal ka atomic faasla X-ray wavelength se milta hai.

items: X-rays: wavelength taqreeban 10^-10 m; crystals qudrati gratings.
Satahon ka faasla aur banawat (haemoglobin, DNA) maloom karne mein.
